reasoning: In Morocco the King appoints the Head of Government from the party that wins the most seats. Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri is Housing Minister, mayor of Marrakech, and a leading member of PAM's collegial leadership. That makes her a plausible PAM nominee if the party finishes first. RNI won in 2021 and, under its new leadership after Akhannouch stepped back, remains the favourite to top the poll. Istiqlal is also a competitor. I put PAM finishing first at roughly 25–30%. If it does, the chance El Mansouri is chosen over other PAM figures is perhaps 40–55%, and her government would still need to win investiture. Overall, about 12%.
